statements.quote: Revenue from our Communications, Enterprise, and Data Center market (CED) grew 137% year over year, fueled by AI that created strong demand for our Precision Timing solutions.
statements.notes: Attributes growth in CED segment revenue (which includes data center) to AI demand. 137% is a growth rate, not an amount or share of revenue, so the class is qualitative. CED also covers communications and enterprise, so it is broader than data-center revenue alone. The period is the quarter ended 2025-06-30, not a full fiscal year.
